description: BUG-12: the gitignore pass got the wrong candidate for a path whose base is a process working directory. `../data/crm.db` from a nested source resolves to nonsense relative to the file, while the path the author meant - `data/crm.db` from the root - is gitignored, i.e. intentionally absent. The root-relative reading now joins the candidate set. A candidate can only suppress a finding, never create one, which is what makes adding it safe: ../gone/x.py, ignored by nothing, is still reported.
